title: 第286章 图穷匕见第285章 化龙之路
slug: 两界我的金手指有点无敌
content_zh:
然而，好友们一个接一个地老去、死去，他却依然年轻如初。
于是他换了一副面孔，换了一个身份，继续在人类的世界中行走。如此反复，不知过了多少年。
终于有一天，他厌倦了。
他厌倦了不断地相识与告别，厌倦了隐藏身份、伪装自我的生活。他脱离了人的世界，回到了水中，回到了那个最初诞生他的地方。
而这一次，他有了一个新的目标，他要成为一条真正的龙。
画面到此缓缓消散，大殿重新恢复了明亮。
龙君停下脚步，转过身来，面对着满堂宾客，微笑道：“这便是本君的故事。今日邀诸位前来，便是想请诸位共同见证本君的化龙之路。”
顾铮听到此处，心中渐渐明朗。他原本有些疑惑，这龙君既然是蛟龙之属，本质上仍属于妖类，按理说应当偏向妖族才对，为何会定下人与妖平等的规矩？
现在听了龙君的经历，他才明白过来。
原来龙君年轻时曾受人类修士救命之恩，又在人类世界中生活了数十年，结交了许多人类好友，因此对人类有着相当的认同感。
这份认同感，使得他在统治这片地域之后，并未像其他妖类霸主那样将人类视为蝼蚁，而是给予了相对平等的生存空间。
画面继续流转。
龙君将白波湖彻底纳入统治之后，势力开始向四周延伸扩张。
然而扩张之路并非一帆风顺，有人类高手闻讯而来，打着“降妖除魔”的旗号，要将他斩杀。
有的被他击败，狼狈退走；有的被他斩杀，尸骨无存；也有势均力敌的对手，与他大战数天数夜，最终两败俱伤，各自退去；甚至还有差点将他杀死的人，他不得不落荒而逃，潜伏了十数年之久，才卷土重来，将那人斩杀。
经历过无数次生死搏杀之后，他终于成为了以白波湖为中心的方圆数百里内无可争议的统治者。
从此之后，再也没有人敢来“降妖除魔”了。
呼~~~
画面泼灭，化作点点光屑消散于空中。
龙君立于众人之前，袖袍飞舞，几如一条随时都可腾飞而起的真龙。

他望着满堂宾客，露出了不加掩饰的漠然神情，那目光中带着一种居高临下的审视，让顾铮等人心头微微发寒。
“你们之中，有一些外来者。”龙君缓缓开口，声音低沉而冷漠，“本君这一生之中，曾遇到过多次外来者。有的成了本君的朋友，有的成了本君的敌人，有的……成了本君的垫脚石。”
他顿了顿，继续说道：“本君曾数次尝试化龙，但都失败了。有个那个外来的好友，告诉我一个办法，为此，本君查阅了许多典籍去证实，耗费了无数心血，终于证实，化龙，也是有捷径的。”
他的目光缓缓扫过大殿，最终落在了敖言溪的身上，嘴角勾起一抹意味深长的笑容：“那便是，与真龙血脉双修。”
顾铮的瞳孔骤然一缩。他脑海中电光火石般闪过一个念头，原来如此。所谓的“龙君祭”，是下面的人理解错了。
龙君想要的，是有真龙血脉的女性作为双修对象，而下面的人却误解为龙君想要貌美的女子，所以才四处抓捕年轻女子献祭。这中间的误会，造成了多少无谓的杀戮。
龙君没有理会众人脸上的神色变化，继续说道：“本君寻觅多年，终于找到了一个女子，她身具三成真龙血脉。只是这血脉是隐性的，形态不显，若无人告知，连她自己都不知道自己拥有真龙血脉。即便如此，三成血脉，已经是本君找到的真龙血脉最为浓厚的双修对象了。”
他张开双臂，声音陡然拔高，带着一股难以抑制的兴奋与期待：“所以，今日这场化龙宴，本来也是本君的大婚之宴！”
话音落下，整座大殿陷入了一瞬间的凝滞。
那层一直维持着的温和表象，在这一刻终于被撕开了一道裂缝，露出了底下真正的意图。
图穷匕见！
青青第一个反应过来，厉声呵斥道：“大泥鳅，你意欲何为！！”
她眼眸含煞，周身气息骤然勃发，衣袍无风自动，显然已经做好了随时动手的准备。
敖言溪的俏脸也沉了下来，眸光冰冷如霜。到了这个时候，她若是还看不出这龙君打的什么算盘，那她就是天底下最大的傻子了。
龙君却丝毫不为所动，甚至还有闲心弹了弹手指。一股无形的力量波动扩散开来，青青只觉得气息一窒，仿佛有一只无形的大手扼住了她的咽喉，让她接下来的话卡在了喉咙里，无法发出。
“莫急，等我说完。”龙君语气平淡，仿佛刚才只是拂去了一只扰人的蚊蝇。
这时，席间有一位宾客按捺不住好奇心，开口问道：“龙君，不知新娘何在？可否让我等一睹芳容？”
龙君闻言，轻轻叹了口气，语气中带着一丝感慨：“本君本以为，三成血脉就是本君所能找到的极限了。没想到啊……”他的目光骤然变得锐利如电，越过满堂宾客，直直地锁定在了敖言溪的身上，“没想到，本君竟然能遇到一个真正的龙女！”
“什么？！”罗霄霍然抬头，满脸错愕。张玄冲也是瞳孔一缩，手中端着的酒杯停在了半空。满堂宾客无不动容，所有人都愣住了。
龙女？真正的龙女？！

“没错，真龙就在我面前。”
龙君的声音带着一种压抑不住的兴奋与渴望，他伸出手，直直指向敖言溪，声音如同雷霆般响彻大殿，“诸位，这就是我的新娘！”
“什么！！！”敖言溪面色一寒，周身寒意骤降，仿佛连大殿的温度都下降了几分。
青青、胡姨、林文、林武更是勃然大怒，四人的气息几乎在同一瞬间爆发开来，如同四座即将喷发的火山。
林文更是直接咆哮出声，声如炸雷：“大泥鳅！放你娘的狗屁！！！”
content_en:
However, his friends grew old and died one after another, but he remained as young as ever.
So he changed his face and identity, and continued to walk in the human world. This happened over and over again, no matter how many years passed.
Finally one day, he got tired of it.
He was tired of constant acquaintances and farewells, tired of hiding his identity and pretending to be himself. He left the human world and returned to the water, back to the place where he was originally born.
But this time, he has a new goal, he wants to become a real dragon.
The scene slowly dissipated and the hall became bright again.
Lord Long stopped, turned around, faced the guests in the hall, and said with a smile: "This is my story. I invite you all to come here today because I want you to witness my journey of transforming into a dragon."
When Gu Zheng heard this, his heart gradually became clear. He was a little confused at first. Since this Dragon Lord is a dragon, he still belongs to the demon race in essence. Logically speaking, he should favor the demon race. Why is there a rule that humans and demons are equal?
Now after hearing Long Jun's experience, he understood.
It turns out that Lord Long was saved by a human monk when he was young. He also lived in the human world for decades and made many human friends, so he had a considerable sense of identification with humans.
This sense of identity made him not regard humans as ants like other demon overlords after he ruled this area, but instead gave them a relatively equal living space.
The picture continues to flow.
After Long Jun completely brought Baibo Lake under his rule, his power began to expand to the surrounding areas.
However, the road to expansion was not smooth sailing. After hearing the news, some human masters came and wanted to kill him under the banner of "subduing demons and slaying demons".
Some were defeated by him and retreated in embarrassment; some were beheaded by him with no bones left; there were also evenly matched opponents who fought with him for days and nights, and eventually both were injured and retreated; there were even people who almost killed him, so he had to flee and lurk for more than ten years before he came back and killed that person.
After experiencing countless life and death battles, he finally became the undisputed ruler within a radius of hundreds of miles centered on Baibo Lake.
From then on, no one dared to "subjugate demons and eliminate demons".
Phew~~~
The screen exploded and turned into specks of light that dissipated in the air.
The Dragon King stood in front of everyone, his sleeves and robes flying, as if he were a real dragon that could soar at any time.
He looked at the guests in the hall with an expression of undisguised indifference. There was a condescending look in his eyes, which made Gu Zheng and others feel slightly chilly.
"There are some outsiders among you." Mr. Long spoke slowly, his voice low and cold, "I have met outsiders many times in my life. Some have become my friends, some have become my enemies, and some... have become my stepping stones."
He paused and continued: "I have tried to transform into a dragon several times, but they all failed. A friend from outside told me a way. To this end, I checked many classics to confirm, spent countless efforts, and finally confirmed that there is a shortcut to transforming into a dragon."
His eyes slowly swept across the hall, and finally fell on Ao Yanxi. A meaningful smile appeared on the corner of his mouth: "That is, dual cultivation with the blood of the true dragon."
Gu Zheng's pupils suddenly shrank. An idea flashed through his mind like a flash of lightning, that's it. The so-called "Dragon King Sacrifice" was misunderstood by the people below.
What the Dragon Lord wants is a woman with true dragon blood as a partner for dual cultivation, but the people below misunderstood that the Dragon Lord wants a beautiful woman, so they go around arresting young women to sacrifice. The misunderstanding in this process caused many unnecessary killings.
Lord Long ignored the changes in expressions on everyone's faces and continued: "I have been searching for many years, and finally found a woman with the blood of a true dragon. It's just that this blood is recessive.She doesn't show it, and if no one tells her, even she herself won't know that she has the blood of a true dragon. Even so, with 30% bloodline, it is already the dual cultivation target with the strongest true dragon bloodline that I have found. "
He opened his arms and his voice suddenly rose, with an uncontrollable excitement and expectation: "So, today's Dragon Transformation Banquet was originally my wedding banquet! "
As soon as the words fell, the entire hall fell into a moment of stagnation.
The gentle surface that had been maintained was finally torn open at this moment, revealing the true intention underneath.
See you in the picture!
Qingqing was the first to react and scolded sternly: "Big Loach, what do you want! ! "
Her eyes were filled with evil, the aura around her body suddenly erupted, her clothes moved automatically without any wind, she was obviously ready to take action at any time.
Ao Yanxi's pretty face also darkened, her eyes as cold as frost. At this point, if she still can't figure out what this Dragon Lord is planning, then she is the biggest fool in the world.
But Long Jun was not moved at all, and even flicked his fingers leisurely. An invisible wave of power spread, and Qingqing felt her breath suffocated, as if an invisible hand had strangled her throat, making her next words stuck in her throat and unable to utter them.
"Don't be anxious, wait until I finish. "Long Jun's tone was calm, as if he just brushed away a disturbing mosquito or fly.
At this time, a guest at the banquet could not restrain his curiosity and asked: "Long Jun, I wonder where the bride is? Can you let me see your beauty? "
Hearing this, Mr. Long sighed softly, with a hint of emotion in his tone: "I originally thought that 30% bloodline was the limit that I could find. I didn't expect..." His eyes suddenly became as sharp as lightning, looking past the guests in the hall, and locked directly on Ao Yanxi, "I didn't expect that I would meet a real dragon girl! "
"What? ! "Luo Xiao suddenly raised his head, with a look of astonishment on his face. Zhang Xuanchong also shrank his pupils, and the wine glass in his hand stopped in mid-air. All the guests in the hall were shocked, and everyone was stunned.
Dragon Girl? The real dragon girl? !
"Yes, the real dragon is right in front of me. "
Long Jun's voice was full of irrepressible excitement and desire. He stretched out his hand and pointed directly at Ao Yanxi, and his voice resounded through the hall like thunder, "Everyone, this is my bride! "
"What! ! ! "Ao Yanxi's face turned cold, and the chill in his whole body dropped sharply, as if even the temperature of the main hall had dropped a few points.
Qing Qing, Aunt Hu, Lin Wen, and Lin Wu were furious. The auras of the four of them exploded almost at the same moment, like four volcanoes about to erupt.
Lin Wen roared loudly like thunder: "Big loach! Damn your motherfucker! ! ! "
